chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from one of our companions who said:

Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) the 3rd said to one of his workers: 'Frequent for us from the aubergines, for it is hot during the time of heat, and cool in the times of coldness, being moderate in all of the times, good upon every state'.
ai.seo_question: What are the health benefits of aubergines according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam Musa al-Kadhim (peace be upon him) directs his household managers to procure aubergines, emphasizing their unique humoral balance in traditional Islamic medicine. The fruit is described as 'hot' during heat and 'cool' during cold, making it an ideal, balanced food (*mu'tadil*) suitable for all seasons and conditions, reflecting the Shia emphasis on practical health wisdom derived from the Imams.
